items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI usage is $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26, conflicting with a prior record of $963.5690377 and 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows are misaligned, period-aligned domain/infrastructure/labor/marketing costs are absent, incremental outcomes are not isolated, and monthly limits are blank. Authorize no discretionary spend, commitments, monetization expansion, forecasts, requeues, or new production work. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failure repair-or-close, and bounded evidence work using existing telemetry only.

Minimum finance measurement: reconcile the conflicting AI-cost records, produce a period-aligned ledger for hosting, domains, labor, marketing, experiments, and other operating costs, and define owner-approved monthly spend and revenue limits. Then reconcile site/content identifiers to attributable commission and measure incremental outcomes against costs before reporting margin, ROI, payback, or cost-to-learn.
